items.question: Where do I start reading code for a new QR type?
items.answer: Open `Smart_QR_UI/src/app/app-routing.module.ts` and find routes under `/qr-codes/type/...` and `/qr-codes/edit/...`. The matching components live under `pages/systematic/modules/qr-code-list/qr-operation/` and `qr-viewer/`.

items.question: Why are API paths prefixed with SmartQRApi?
items.answer: The backend exposes Smart QR under a single controller/route prefix `SmartQRApi`. The UI builds URLs as `${environment.baseApiUrl}/SmartQRApi/...` in `qr-code.service.ts` and related services.

items.question: How do I run the UI against a different API?
items.answer: Change `baseApiUrl` in `Smart_QR_UI/src/environments/environment.ts` (or the prod file for production builds), restart `ng serve`, and ensure CORS is allowed on the API.

items.question: What is the difference between GetQR and GetQRPublic?
items.answer: **GetQR** is for authenticated owners editing a QR. **GetQRPublic** serves viewer-facing data for end users who only have a QR id from a link or scan.

items.question: Where is AdminGuard used?
items.answer: Admin-only routes (e.g. loyalty dashboard, admin QR management) list `canActivate: [AdminGuard]` in `app-routing.module.ts`. Pair with **Smart QR — Auth** for role storage details.
